runs.text: Read 5 marks, from 0 to 10, and show the highest. The program shows only the number.

hints.text: Do you know how many marks there are? That decides which way of repeating suits.
You need a box that remembers the highest seen so far. Look at its roles in
What value does that box start with? Think of a value that is sure to work.
Read the first mark into the highest box; then, four passes that read and replace if the new one is greater. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Also show in which position, from 1 to 5, the highest first appeared.
Hidden cases: the highest at the end and at the start. Frequent mistake: starting the highest at 0, which works with marks from 0 to 10 but fails with temperatures below zero.
